set_desc: Set atmosphere fields (Rayleigh/Mie scattering, anisotropy, ground albedo, radius, height, multi-scattering, aerial perspective, height fog) of a SkyAtmosphere actor found by label or name, through the component's setters, which refresh its render state; set_properties writes any other field. Only supplied fields change, in one undo step; all are read back. Colors are linear [R,G,B(,A)], ground_albedo [R,G,B(,A)] whole 0-255 bytes. A malformed field, or a component of Static mobility (its setters change nothing; make it Movable first), is an error and nothing changes. Not saved.
get_desc: Read the atmosphere settings of a SkyAtmosphere actor's component, found by label or name in the editor world, under the snake_case names set_sky_atmosphere_properties takes (Rayleigh/Mie scattering, ground albedo, planet radius, height). A curated view; get_properties (internal names only) reads any other UPROPERTY on the component.

fields.desc: Optional [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A] ground albedo, each a whole number from 0 to 255 (FColor; A defaults to 255).
Optional aerial perspective view distance scale.
